description: Label and group Go ecosystem updates. The go directive in go.mod is a consumer compatibility floor, so it is kept out of the dependency group and off automerge. go.work is deliberately left alone: it is a local selector, not a floor, and nothing published reads it

packageRules.description: Group non-major Go module updates into a single PR

The go directive is the oldest Go a consumer may build this module with, not the Go this repo builds with, so it stays out of the dependency group and never automerges. Renovate is deliberately left on the stock go-mod-directive versioning, which proposes nothing by itself: go mod tidy already raises the directive when a dependency demands it, and raises it to the lowest version that satisfies the demand, which is both the only correct trigger and the only correct target. Overriding the versioning to chase the newest release instead forces every consumer onto the latest Go. Whether the floor is still inside the supported window is a question for CI, which can build and test at the floor itself
